expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Three cities, two countries and two nights at a five star on the Mekong at Phnom Penh. The capital is usually skipped and it should not be.
expert.tip: Tuol Sleng is hard going. Keep the afternoon light after it and sit on the riverfront with a coffee.

summary: Eight days through two countries: three nights in Saigon with the city, the Cu Chi tunnels and the Mekong Delta, two at a five star riverside retreat in Phnom Penh with a guided day of the capital, then two in Siem Reap for Tonle Sap and a full day at Angkor.
included: Included: 7 nights with breakfast daily and dinner at the Saigon and Siem Reap hotels, including two at a five star riverside retreat; all flights between the cities; private transfers throughout; a Saigon city tour with the Cu Chi tunnels; a Mekong Delta day tour; a Phnom Penh city tour; a Tonle Sap lake boat ride; an Angkor Wat day tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam and Cambodia visa fees; lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
